import base64,hashlib,json,sys
Q=json.loads(base64.b64decode("@@Q_BASE64@@",validate=True))
SOURCE="@@SOURCE_SHA@@"
canon=lambda x:json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False)
reason="REQUEST_VALID";code=0;payload={"readonly":True}
if Q.get("op")=="EXIT17":reason="DIAGNOSTIC_EXIT17";code=17
elif Q.get("op")=="REFUSAL":reason="INTENDED_REFUSAL";code=23
elif Q.get("op")=="VALIDATE":
 if not isinstance(Q.get("store"),str) or not Q["store"]:reason="STORE_INVALID";code=23
 elif Q.get("name")!=Q["store"]:reason="NAME_INVALID";code=23
 elif Q.get("scope")!="plan55-readonly":reason="SCOPE_INVALID";code=23
 elif not isinstance(Q.get("value"),str):reason="SERIALIZATION_INVALID";code=23
 else:payload={"value":Q["value"],"value_sha256":hashlib.sha256(Q["value"].encode()).hexdigest()}
else:reason="ACTION_INVALID";code=23
out={"schema":"p55-transport-v1","op":Q["op"],"case_id":Q["case_id"],"mode":Q.get("mode","readonly"),"source_sha256":SOURCE,"request_sha256":hashlib.sha256(canon(Q).encode()).hexdigest(),"logical_exit":code,"reason":reason,"authority":False,"runtime_admission":False,"proposed_writes":[],"payload":payload,"end":"P55_TRANSPORT_END"}
raw=(canon(out)+"\n").encode()
if len(raw)>16384:raise SystemExit(23)
sys.stdout.buffer.write(raw);sys.stdout.buffer.flush();raise SystemExit(code)

python3 -B - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess
root=pathlib.Path('.')
old=json.loads((root/'.planning/phases/16-host-evidence-and-roadmap/16-50-TERMINAL-PROVENANCE.json').read_text())['complete_retained_records']
expected=old['p50-baseline']['dirty_hashes']
actual={p:hashlib.sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in expected}
meta=[]
for item in old['p50-terminal-check']['metadata_only']:
 p=root/item['path'];s=p.lstat()
 current={'path':item['path'],'mode':s.st_mode&0o7777,'size':s.st_size,'mtime_ns':s.st_mtime_ns,'inode':s.st_ino}
 if current!=item: raise SystemExit('METADATA_ONLY_CHANGED '+item['path'])
 meta.append(current)
retained=root/'build/phase16-validation38-bootstrap/copy-operations.jsonl'
before=retained.lstat();b=retained.read_bytes();after=retained.lstat()
assert (before.st_ino,before.st_size,before.st_mtime_ns)==(after.st_ino,after.st_size,after.st_mtime_ns)
assert len(b)==13136 and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()=='5d9dc44bca2c69a9d4e5ac248ae1d9942c4cafd9ee4e208902b6b87695d9b195'
git=lambda *args:subprocess.check_output(['git',*args],text=True).strip()
index=pathlib.Path(git('rev-parse','--git-path','index'))
roots={f'build/phase16-validation{n}{suffix}':(root/f'build/phase16-validation{n}{suffix}').exists() for n in range(50,56) for suffix in ('','-bootstrap','-preflight')}
phase=root/'.planning/phases/16-host-evidence-and-roadmap'
success={f'16-{n}-{suffix}.md':(phase/f'16-{n}-{suffix}.md').exists() for n in range(50,56) for suffix in ('PREPARATION','SUMMARY')}
assert actual==expected
assert not any(roots.values()) and not any(success.values())
assert git('diff','--cached','--name-only')==''
print(json.dumps({'schema':'plan55-administrative-preservation-v1','head':git('rev-parse','HEAD'),'branch':git('branch','--show-current'),'index_sha256':hashlib.sha256(index.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'dirty_hashes':actual,'all_six_match':True,'staged':git('diff','--cached','--name-only'),'roots':roots,'success_artifacts':success,'metadata_only':meta,'retained38':{'length':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()},'whole_history_comparison':False,'canonical_capture':False,'transport_acceptance':False},sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')))
PY
